english_title: Proposition 1.2.5: A Necessary Condition for a Cauchy Sequence
statement_en: If $(a_n)$ is a Cauchy sequence, then for every fixed positive integer $p$, $$|a_{n+p}-a_n|\to 0.$$
key_techniques: apply the Cauchy condition to shifted indices
callout_body: 如果是序列$(a_n)$是柯西列，那么对于任意固定的正整数$p$都有$$|a_{n+p}-a_n|\to 0$$
